title: Home visits for small animals in Kotka–Hamina region
intro: Home veterinary visits for small animals in the Kotka–Hamina region. Some treatments that can be done in a clinic can also be performed at home. Veterinarian Oleg Melentev provides home visits in the Kotka–Hamina area. Visits to farther locations are possible by agreement.
question: What procedures can be done at home?
item1: Vaccination, microchipping, pet passport, EU passport
item3: Ear and eye exams, skin diseases, ear and skin samples
item4: Health check and senior health check
item5: Vomiting and diarrhea treatment and other first aid
more: Please contact me if a needed service is not listed.
price_intro: Price examples for home visits. Prices are estimates for non-urgent care, distance ≤20 km, including visit fee, procedure, and estimated medications and supplies.
price_example1: Ear infection treatment, including examination and ear sample — 145 €.
price_example2: Eye infection treatment, including examination and staining — 136 €.
puppies_title: Litter examination, health certificate and microchipping
closing1: Visits are arranged by phone at a time convenient for the client. Same-day visits are often possible. If needed, I recommend further treatment at a clinic.
closing2: Although many procedures can be done at home, treatment options are more limited than in a clinic. Not all diseases can be treated at home. The veterinarian always evaluates the situation individually.
not_suitable: When is a home visit not suitable?
not_suitable_list1: Patients requiring intensive care or hospitalization
not_suitable_list2: Cases requiring X-rays, advanced diagnostics or surgery
price_includes: The cost of a home visit consists of the visit fee, procedure fee, and possible laboratory, medication, and supply costs.
visit_fee: Procedure fee (30–60 min): 96 € + travel fee. Emergency surcharge +50–100%
emergency_text: Emergency visits 12:00–21:00. No night service. Urgent cases are prioritized.
payment: Payment methods: cash, card, contactless, Google Pay, Apple Pay.
footanote: When booking, it is recommended to request a price estimate. Prices may change. All prices include VAT. Medications, laboratory tests, and cremation services are not included.
